Keeper Cost
rows.value: Up to 4 keepers per team, $10 extra each

rows.label: Draft Position
rows.value: Kept players retain the draft position they were picked at the prior year

rows.label: Waiver Pickups
rows.value: A player added off waivers counts as a last-round pick for keeper purposes

rows.label: Last-Round Keeper Bump
rows.value: If a new waiver-pickup keeper needs the last (15th) round slot and it's already held by an existing keeper, that keeper's cost moves up one round to make room -- and if another keeper is already sitting in that round too, it cascades up one round in turn (for example: a keeper already at the 14th round moves to 13th, and the keeper at 15th moves to 14th, to make room for the new waiver keeper coming in at 15th)

rows.label: Trades
rows.value: No preseason trades -- trading is in-season only. A team cannot end up with more than 15 total draft picks. Same keeper rules apply after a trade: kept at original draft position, or last-round pick if they were a waiver add by the other team. If you trade away a draft pick, you cannot keep a player in that round's spot -- you'd need to reacquire that pick in a trade first.

rows.label: Drop & Re-add (Same Team)
rows.value: If a team drafts, drops, and re-adds the same player, they keep their original drafted position (prevents gaming keeper value)

rows.label: Starters
rows.value: QB, WR, WR, WR, RB, RB, TE, W/R/T, K, DEF
